title: Contract Transfer on Sale and Tenant Contact Changes — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**T1.** When a landlord sells a covered rental property to a purchaser who will keep renting it, the Rental Property Service Contracts contract may be transferred instead of cancelled, provided the tier allows transfer (every tier does).

**T2.** A transfer is processed only while the contract status is waiting period or active.

**T3.** A transfer is processed only when the contract's premium balance is zero or less.

**T4.** The purchaser must have a landlord customer profile on file and consents to the transfer as their own decision; the purchaser becomes the contract holder on the transfer date, keeps the current term, tier, billing frequency and the term's portfolio discount, and is billed the tier's transfer fee ($25.00 on every tier). The selling landlord receives no refund on a transfer.

**T5.** The authorized tenant contact is changed only on the instruction of the current contract holder, and is cleared at tenant turnover; a former tenant's requests are no longer accepted after the change.

T2 and T3 are read from the system record of the contract being transferred, before the transfer.

## T2 and T3 together

| Contract status | Premium balance | Transfer |
|---|---|---|
| waiting period or active | zero or less | processed |
| waiting period or active | above zero | not processed |
| suspended for nonpayment, expired or cancelled | any | not processed |

*Hypothetical:* an active contract with a credit balance of $12.00 owed back to the landlord may be transferred; the same contract owing $61.74 may not.
